{{Quote|A terrible man who goes by the name of Orga Presari leads the slavers. His cruelty is exceeded only by his greed. Two bodyguards always accompany him. They are not pleasant individuals.|Ikka Gesul|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Orga Presari''' was [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] by the name of [[Ikka Gesul]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Presari and his two [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orga Presari was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
